candidates.summary: the gnodev watch covers the boot only: died is drained by waitReady, so a node that dies during the crawl is swallowed and a partial preview publishes green
candidates.failure_scenario: render() reaches waitReady, which consumes the single buffered value from died and returns nil; from then on nothing reads the channel. gnodev then dies mid-crawl (a panic rendering a realm, the runner's OOM killer, the 5 GB gnodev process on a 25-realm plan). Every later Crawler.get dials a closed port, crawl.go:129-131 prints `! <url>: connection refused` to stderr and continues, and Run() returns nil. render() goes on to Write, Index and Comment and exits 0, so the job is green and gno-previews receives a snapshot holding whatever was captured before the death, with the sticky comment linking every realm in the plan including the ones that have no page. Measured: 1 of 3 realm pages captured, Run() == nil.

candidates.summary: gnodev local chdirs on -C, so the -home path built from cfg.out lands under examples/ instead of the output dir and the workflow's cleanup of it deletes nothing
candidates.failure_scenario: startGnodev passes `-C <root>/examples` and `-home filepath.Join(cfg.out, ".gnodev-<port>")`. contribs/gnodev/command_local.go:87-89 runs os.Chdir(cfg.chdir) before anything resolves home, and app_config.go:63-65 stores -home verbatim, so with the CI's relative `-out _preview` the keybase is created at <root>/examples/_preview/.gnodev-8899/ rather than inside the output directory. pr-preview.yml:103's `rm -rf _preview/gnodev.log _preview/gnodev-base.log _preview/.gnodev-*` then matches nothing for the keybase, and a developer running `gnopreview render -out _preview` locally is left with an untracked _preview/ tree of generated keys inside examples/, which git status reports on every later branch. The port-derived isolation the comment above the flag argues for still holds; only the location does not.

candidates.summary: render only MkdirAlls -out and never clears it, so a second run over an existing directory publishes pages from the previous plan that Index never lists
candidates.failure_scenario: The package doc calls render the step that "boot gnodev, crawl, write the tree". A rerun after a plan shrinks (a realm removed from the PR, -max-realms lowered) writes the new pages over the old ones and leaves every page the earlier plan captured on disk. Crawler.Write writes only what it captured, and Index(plan, c) lists only c.pages, so the stale files are published and served but linked from nothing; on the CI path they would also count toward the 40 MiB cap pr-preview-publish.yml enforces. CI always starts from a fresh checkout, so this is a local-run and rerun hazard only.
